impressions.text: The delivery is vworlds/vmethod PR 198 implementing issue 193's three specification points: a conflict card state showing the fixing worker as assignee during resolution, a one-line dispatch NOTE posted on the PR thread, and a stale-wake guard that drops queued wakes older than the worker's latest protocol reply.

The glm-flash worker delivered all three behaviors in round 1 as a single commit with acceptance-mapped unit tests (61 files / 1371 tests) and green format, lint, typecheck, build, smoke, knip, and CI checks.

The round-1 review rejected the worker's own disclosed deviation 2, because the stale-wake guard could drop an ANSWER wake that was never answered, requiring that conflict-fixer replies not count as the worker's latest protocol reply plus a test proving the queued ANSWER is delivered.
Round 2 fixed this with a dispatch-NOTE attribution window that excludes fixer replies from the staleness anchor, added the required delivery test to reach 1372 tests, and remained fully green.
Afterward the orchestrator posted OWNER REVIEW at head adbddf4, and the PR merged with grade Estimate 1 at USD $0.369722.
